name: prompt-shaper
description: Catches a long, messy prompt before Claude reads it, asks only the questions that change the outcome (each with a default), then fills the prompt box with a clear brief: the job, the why, the guardrails, what done means and the assumptions.

minWords.title: Shortest prompt to shape
minWords.description: Prompts with fewer words than this are sent as typed.

maxQuestions.title: Most questions to ask
maxQuestions.description: Only questions whose answer changes the outcome are asked, up to this many (0 to 5). 0 never asks.

workingRules.title: Add the working rules
workingRules.description: End the brief with rules for Claude: restate and say what a bare go does before starting, finish with a Not done list, and stop at a draft for anything outward facing.

model.title: Model that writes the questions and the brief
model.description: Haiku is fastest and cheapest; Sonnet or Opus write sharper briefs.
